prerequisites: It is recommended to have drawing knowledge, at the level of studies completed in high school.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand and know the fundamental principles governing geometric constructions.
Understand and know the fundamental principles governing representation systems to interpret and represent engineering drawings.
Be able to know and apply representation standards and incorporate the use of technical terms in language.
Be able to know, understand and use computer-aided design programs to represent engineering drawings.
Be able to understand, know and use graphic visualization techniques to improve spatial vision linked to engineering.

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a minimum grade of 5 out of 10 is required on the final theoretical/practical exam (ETP1) and a minimum grade of 5 out of 10 on the average of laboratory practices (PL) or the laboratory practice exam. If all minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as 0.5 * ETP1 + 0.1 * PA + 0.2 * PL + 0.2 * TIG. Otherwise, the grade will be the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0. For extraordinary calls, a minimum of 5 out of 10 is required on the final theoretical/practical exam (ETP2) and a minimum of 5 out of 10 on the individual CAD program knowledge exam (EPL). The final grade is calculated using the same formula as the ordinary call (with ETP2 and EPL replacing ETP1 and PL, respectively) and similar conditions apply.
